rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZ ING SKILLS TRAINING AND RETRAINING
rows.abstract: "Skills Training and Retraining Act". Formulates the following mechanisms that will affirm labor as the primary social economic force: (1) provide adequate and relevant skills training and retraining programs to suffice the needs of the industry; and (2) update the standard skills and introduce new crafts to prepare workers for their employment and re-employment.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-30

rows.author: B012
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR INCENTIVES TO THE SHIPBREAKING INDUSTRY, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Shipbreaking Industry Incentives Act of 1998". Declares it the policy of the government to promote, encourage and accelerate the development and growth of the shipbreaking industry to (1) provide an alternate and economical source of iron and steel for the construction industries; (2) to create more job opportunities for Filipino workers; (3) to save and generate foreign exchange earningsp; (4) to augment and support the material requirements of the shipping indsutry; and (5) to encouragethe replacement of unseaworthy vessels in the interisland fleet.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1998-07-30

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING FROM INCOME TAXATION THE FIRST THREE YEARS SALARY OF SCHOOL TEACHERS, BOTH IN PUBLIC AND PRIVATE ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS
rows.abstract: States that giving income tax exemptions to NEW teachers during their first three (3) years of service could be an added incentive that will not only help solve the problem of teacher shortage, but also improve the quality of elementary and secondary edcuation in public and private schools.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-30

rows.abstract: "Public School Teachers' Incentive Act of 1998". Explains that the incentives granted to public school teachers who are to be assigned in towns or provinces different from their own are supposed to answer for the physical and economic dislocation ofthe teachers who are presumably working in other places because they could not be assigned in their own towns or provinces.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING SMOKING IN PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION AND BUILDINGS, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Provides that any person who violates this Act shall be punished with imprisonment of not less than  five (5) days nor more than ten (10) days or a fine of not more than Five Hundred Pesos (P500.00) nor more than One Thousand Pesos (P1,000.00) or both.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06211

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING BARANGAY NUTRITION SCHOLAR ASSIGNED TO NUTRITIONALLY DEPRESSED AREAS AN ANNUAL TRAVEL ALLOWANCE OF TWO THOUSAND PESOS (P2,000.00), AMENDING  FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED FIFTEEN HUNDRED SIXTY NINE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Underscores the importance of the presence of the Barangay Nutrition Scholar as being indispensable in the implementation of barangay nutrition programs. Seeks to alleviate the plight of the people in economically and nutritionally depressed areas.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-07-30

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A MAGNA CARTA OF AGRICULTURAL OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES
rows.abstract: "Magna Carta of Agricultural Officers and Employees of 1998". Promotes the welfare of the agricultural sector by improving the economic and social well-being of the agricultural officers and employees, their standard of living as well as elevate their working conditions and employment status.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1998-07-30

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GOAT BREEDING CENTER IN EVERY PROVINCE OF THE PHILIPPINES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Explains that goat raising will benefit not only the farmers, but it will also involve the out-of-school youth and children in cooperative ventures while it also helps augment the income of the families aside from providing a source for necessary nutritional requirements.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1998-07-30

rows.abstract: Reasons that the dedication and committed services of the barangay officials to their constituencies at the grassroots level deserves them no less than the recognition of the vital role they play in maintaining public order and social stability.
rows.status: Substituted by HB11749

rows.author: A007
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE OF THE OFFICE OF THE SPECIAL PROSECUTOR AND THE FUNCTIONS THEREOF, INDEPENDENT OF THE OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6770, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Special Prosecutor Act of 1998". Explains that the organizational structure of the Office of the Special Prosecutor should be defined clearly in accordance with the Constitution.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING PHONE SEX BUSINESS AND ITS RELATED ACTIVITIES AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR THE VIOLATORS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Defines "phone sex business" as any acitivity carried out for profit that deals with taped or actual phone conversation relating to sex subjects including publicity , advertising, promotion, solicitation, production and operation thereof. Imposes penalty for violation of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C094
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZ ING KINDERGARTEN EDUCATION AS PART OF THE COMPULSORY BASIC FORMAL EDUCATION AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Kindergarten Act of 1998". Declares it a State policy to provide equal opportunities for all five-year old Filipino children to avail of free and compulsory kindergarten education that effectively promote physical, social, intellectual and skills stimulation and value-formation .
rows.status: Substituted by HB11692

rows.author: C094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 13(c)(4) OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7227, ENTITLED 'AN ACT ACCELERATING THE CONVERSION OF MILITARY RESERVATIONS INTO OTHER PRODUCTIVE USES, CREATING THE BASES CONVERSION AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY FOR THIS PURPOSE, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES"
rows.abstract: Makes the TERM of the Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority CO-TERMINOUS with the appointing authority that may only serve at the pleasure of the Chief Executive, just like the Cabinet secretaries and other executive officials.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECONOMIC AFFAIRS since 1998-07-30

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE IMPOSITION OF AN IDLE LAND TAX, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE PERTINENT PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: Ensures the collectibility and efficienty of the idle lands tax by (1) giving it a national perspective to compel local implementation; (2) redefining idle land; and (3) providing for a 60-40 sharing between the national and local government, respectively.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-30

rows.author: A081
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING A LAND CONVERSION TAX, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Imposes a land conversion tax of ten percent (10%) on all agricultural lands converted for residential purposes, anf fifteen percent (15%) for commercial, industrial and other than non-agricultura l purposes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-30
